Stourbridge Residents Warned Away After Wildfires Destroy Homes

Residents of Stourbridge were told to stay away from the area following multiple house fires caused by wildfires. Thursday was described by residents as 'horrendous' and 'distressing', with over a dozen homes devastated by the blazes. Some residents attributed the fires to climate change. Emergency services were present at the scene.
